verdict.rationale: An agent that drives a real iPhone through an ESP32 pointer and moves freely between apps is exactly the kind of product where an enforced app or account allowlist is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows the agent leaving its own app to operate others (Clock, Settings) and lets users edit plain-text prompts, but documents no allowlist, blocklist, or enforced scope limit. Editable prompts would be advisory steering at best, not enforcement.

support.subject: As an operator, I can limit which apps, surfaces, or accounts the agent may touch, and the limit is enforced, not advisory
